texts:
Heat Check for Week 8: who is earning more of the ball and who is losing it, with the number and the reasons for each. Snaps, routes and targets, not box scores.

Biggest riser: #DaBears Colston Loveland.
Biggest faller: #JetUp Garrett Wilson.

Let's get into it.

#DaBears Colston Loveland, CHI TE: led Chicago with 12 targets vs NE and caught 7 for 69 and a TD on 84 percent of the snaps.
TE6 rest of season for me. Buy him before Kmet's snaps show up in his box score.

#RaiderNation Tre Tucker, LV WR: caught 5 of 12 targets for 103 and a TD vs LAR on 82 percent of the snaps.
WR40 rest of season for me, and the targets say higher. Claim him.

#DawgPound KC Concepcion Jr., CLE WR: caught 8 of 10 targets for 129 at TEN on 79 percent of the snaps, the most targets on the Browns, and added 3 carries for 23.
WR37 rest of season for me. Add him.

#FlyEaglesFly Makai Lemon, PHI WR: snap share up from 70 percent in Week 3 to 91 Monday, and 7 of 8 for 67 and a TD with DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks out.
WR50 rest of season for me. Add him.

#Skol Jordan Mason, MIN RB: 38 snaps to Aaron Jones Sr.'s 15 in his first game off IR, 15 carries for 68.
RB26 rest of season for me. Claim him.

Jones aggravated the MCL. RB33 for me. Monitor Wednesday's Vikings report.

#BroncosCountry Jonah Coleman, DEN RB: 30 snaps off IR, the most of any Denver back.
RB27 rest of season for me. Claim him.

J.K. Dobbins, DEN RB: snap share 52, 52, then 23 percent.
RB42 for me. Drop him for Coleman.

#DaBears D'Andre Swift, CHI RB: played 54 snaps vs NE to Roschon Johnson's 10 and ran 22 times for 78 and a TD with Kyle Monangai out a third game.
RB10 rest of season for me. Hold him; Monangai back at practice is what would change the call.

#PhinsUp Ollie Gordon II, MIA RB: ran 25 times for 103 and a TD at NYJ on 83 percent of the snaps in Miami's first win. Jaylen Wright played 8 snaps before a quad injury, and his Week 8 status vs NE is open.
RB19 rest of season for me. Add him.

#DirtyBirds Michael Penix Jr., ATL QB: went 25 of 34 for 213 and 3 TDs vs SF after 3 TDs vs CHI, with no interception in his last three games.
QB18 rest of season for me. Add him in superflex.

#Saints Alvin Kamara, NO RB: snap share up from 26 to 56 percent, 7 of 7 targets vs PIT.
RB40 for me. Hold him through the bye; Etienne back at practice changes it.

Kendre Miller, NO RB: 8 carries for 6 yards.
RB50 for me. Drop him for any add on the list.

#TitanUp Elic Ayomanor, TEN WR: drew 7 targets vs CLE, 23 percent of the throws, after 2 in each of the two games before, and caught 3 for 44 with Calvin Ridley inactive.
WR98 rest of season for me. Add him in deep leagues.

#DallasCowboys Ryan Flournoy, DAL WR: 4 of 4 for 70 at PHI, and 13 targets to Jake Ferguson's 4 over two games.
WR60 for me. Add him in deep leagues, 0 to 2 percent.

Ferguson: target share 14, 6, then 4 percent. TE28 for me. Drop him for any tight end on the list.

Now the fallers.

#JetUp Garrett Wilson, NYJ WR: caught 2 of 3 targets for 26 vs MIA on 85 percent of the snaps, while Omar Cooper Jr. caught 5 for 115 and a TD. Aaron Glenn put the missing targets on himself.
WR17 rest of season for me. Monitor his targets vs LV Sunday.

#OnePride Sam LaPorta, DET TE: 97 percent of the snaps vs GB and 1 catch on 2 targets for 18.
Amon-Ra St. Brown drew 11 targets.

LaPorta is TE5 rest of season for me. Monitor his targets vs MIN Sunday.

#NYGiants Isaiah Likely, NYG TE: caught 2 of 4 targets at HOU in J.J. McCarthy's first start, after 24 targets over the two weeks before.
TE4 rest of season for me. Monitor his targets at PHI in Week 9.

#HereWeGo Germie Bernard, PIT WR: caught 3 of 5 for 27 vs NO on 91 percent of the snaps, while Rico Dowdle drew 6 targets out of the backfield.
WR42 rest of season for me. Monitor his targets vs CLE Sunday.

#RamsHouse Kyren Williams, LAR RB: snap share 73, 72, then 51 percent, as Blake Corum's carries went 5, 9, 17.
RB7 for me. Monitor the split vs LAC Sunday.

Tyler Higbee, LAR TE: 3 targets at LV.
TE24 for me. Drop him for any tight end on the list.

#KeepPounding Chuba Hubbard, CAR RB: 28 carries, then 7 vs TB. The score did most of it.
RB11 for me. Monitor his carries at GB Thursday night.

Bryce Young, CAR QB: pulled in the fourth after 5 sacks.
QB15 for me. Monitor Dave Canales' word on Thursday's starter.

#NEPats TreVeyon Henderson, NE RB: played 13 snaps at CHI, and Mike Vrabel said he wants Corey Kiner to get carries too. Rhamondre Stevenson played 69 percent.
RB38 rest of season for me. Sell him before Corey Kiner takes more carries.

#RaiderNation Mike Washington Jr., LV RB: played 18 snaps vs LAR and ran 6 times for 27, while Ashton Jeanty went back up to 72 percent.
RB45 rest of season for me. Drop him for any add on the list.

#Saints Juwan Johnson, NO TE: has 1 catch for 7 yards over the last two games, on 58 and 56 percent of the snaps. New Orleans is on bye in Week 8.
TE17 rest of season for me. Drop him for any tight end on the list.

Every riser and faller, with the number and the reasons behind it, is on the site. Follow @FF_ChefHazy for the rest of the week's calls, and repost this for your league.

https://fantasykitchenff.com/heat.html?week=8
